trait.name: Reckless Attack
entries: When the bruiser makes its first attack on its turn, it can attack recklessly. Doing so gives it advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during this turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

bonus.name: Rage (3/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, the bruiser enters a rage for up to 1 minute. While raging, it has advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, it gains a +2 bonus to damage rolls with melee weapon attacks using Strength, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. If the bruiser is able to cast spells, it can't cast them or concentrate on them while raging.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The bruiser makes two greataxe attacks.

action.name: Greataxe
entries: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 4) slashing damage, or 13 (1d12 + 6) slashing damage while raging.
